wissen.n.chips_euv.satz: Machines that hardly anyone can build today: decades and billions.

wissen.n.batt_zellfabrik.satz: Cells for cars and grid storage from domestic production.
wissen.n.energie_fusion_forschung.name: Fusion Research

wissen.n.meer_offshore_wind.satz: More power from the sea, less gas from abroad.

wissen.n.energie_fusion_testreaktor.satz: A wonder with an open outcome, built over decades.

wissen.n.luft_triebwerke.satz: Our own engines: the bottleneck of every fighter jet and aircraft.

wissen.n.raum_satelliten.satz: Our own eyes and ears in space: Earth observation, communications, navigation.

wissen.n.luft_regionalflugzeug.satz: A civil aircraft built at home, if the market accepts it.
wissen.n.luft_flugtaxi.name: Air Taxi Network
wissen.n.luft_flugtaxi.satz: Flying above the traffic jam; expensive and uncertain.
wissen.n.raum_bahnhof.name: Spaceport
wissen.n.raum_bahnhof.satz: A launch site on the south coast for our own rockets.

wissen.n.raum_traeger.satz: Putting satellites into orbit ourselves instead of buying launches.
wissen.n.raum_mondsonde.name: Moon Mission
wissen.n.raum_mondsonde.satz: A soft landing on the Moon: pride and prestige.
wissen.n.raum_orbit_bemannt.name: Crewed Orbital Mission
wissen.n.raum_orbit_bemannt.satz: People from our own country in orbit.
wissen.n.raum_mondbasis.name: Moon Base
wissen.n.raum_mondbasis.satz: A permanent station; only with partners and a lot of luck.
wissen.n.raum_mars.name: Crewed Mars Mission
wissen.n.raum_mars.satz: The most distant goal; hardly any country dares.
wissen.n.raum_aufzug.name: Space Elevator
wissen.n.raum_aufzug.satz: An engineers' dream, perhaps never buildable.
wissen.n.mil_drohnen.name: Drone Fleet
wissen.n.mil_drohnen.satz: Today's standing: combat drones from domestic production.
wissen.n.mil_huerjet.name: Hürjet
wissen.n.mil_huerjet.satz: A domestic trainer jet that can also be exported.
wissen.n.mil_altay.name: Altay Main Battle Tank
wissen.n.mil_altay.satz: Our own tank; the powerpack remains the difficult question.
wissen.n.mil_kaan_motor.name: Own Fighter Engine
wissen.n.mil_kaan_motor.satz: Without a foreign engine, the fighter jet is truly ours.
wissen.n.mil_stahlkuppel.name: Steel Dome
wissen.n.mil_stahlkuppel.satz: Multi-layered air defence from domestic systems.
wissen.n.ki_militaer.name: AI Battle Management
wissen.n.ki_militaer.satz: Drone swarms and a real-time picture; Washington dislikes it.
wissen.n.meer_uwdrohnen.name: Underwater Drones
wissen.n.meer_uwdrohnen.satz: Surveillance of the seabed, from cables to gas fields.
wissen.n.mil_kaan.name: KAAN Fighter Jet
wissen.n.mil_tf2000.name: TF-2000 Destroyer
wissen.n.mil_tf2000.satz: Large ships for air defence at sea.
wissen.n.meer_uboote.name: National Submarines
wissen.n.meer_uboote.satz: Submarines of domestic design; the neighbours arm in response.
wissen.n.bio_genomik.name: National Genome Programme
wissen.n.bio_genomik.satz: Knowing the population's genome: the basis for medicine and farming.
wissen.n.bio_impfstoffwerk.name: Vaccine and Drug Plant
wissen.n.bio_impfstoffwerk.satz: Domestic vaccines and active ingredients: fewer medicine imports.
wissen.n.bio_saatgut.name: Seeds and Agri-Biotech
wissen.n.bio_saatgut.satz: Varieties that withstand drought and heat.
wissen.n.bio_medizintechnik.name: Medical Technology Cluster
wissen.n.bio_medizintechnik.satz: Devices and implants from our own country, also for export.
wissen.n.bio_gentherapie.name: Gene Therapy Programme
wissen.n.bio_gentherapie.satz: Cures for rare diseases; expensive and uncertain.
wissen.n.nano_zentrum.name: Nanomaterials Centre
wissen.n.nano_zentrum.satz: Graphene and composites for light, strong components.
wissen.n.robotik_offensive.name: Robotics Drive
wissen.n.robotik_offensive.satz: Factories become more productive; some jobs disappear.
wissen.n.meer_institut.name: Marine Research Institute
wissen.n.meer_institut.satz: The country gets to know its three seas better than its neighbours.
wissen.n.meer_hafenautomatisierung.name: Port Automation
wissen.n.meer_tiefsee_gas.name: Deep-Sea Gas
wissen.n.meer_tiefsee_gas.satz: More domestic gas from the Black Sea, if the drilling hits.
wissen.n.meer_tiefseebergbau.name: Deep-Sea Mining
wissen.n.meer_tiefseebergbau.satz: Metals from the seabed; environmentalists are up in arms.
wissen.z.digital.name: Chips and AI
wissen.z.digital.satz: Computing power, chips and artificial intelligence: the basis for government, economy and defence.
wissen.z.energie.name: Energy
wissen.z.energie.satz: Fewer gas and oil imports: storage, wind, hydrogen, nuclear, and fusion as a distant goal.
wissen.z.luftraum.name: Aerospace
wissen.z.luftraum.satz: Engines, aircraft, satellites and rockets: from bottleneck to our own capability.
wissen.z.ruestung.name: Defence
wissen.z.ruestung.satz: Our own weapons instead of purchases: more independent in a crisis, more expensive in peacetime.
wissen.z.bio.name: Bio and Health
wissen.z.bio.satz: Genomes, vaccines, seeds and medical technology: health and harvests from our own knowledge.
wissen.z.werkstoff.name: Materials and Sea
wissen.z.werkstoff.satz: New materials, robots and the riches of our own seas.
wissen.grund.bildung: Too few engineers and researchers: {was} {jetzt} of {ziel}. Expand education and universities; it takes years to show.
wissen.grund.foerderung: Research funding too low: level {jetzt} of {ziel}. Raise it in the policy network.
wissen.grund.verwaltung: The administration is stretched: finish running projects first.
wissen.satz.verpufft: Research money is fizzling out: {verpufft, prozent, 1} of GDP lies above the innovation ceiling of {grenze, prozent, 1}. Expand education first; then more research pays off.
wissen.satz.abwanderung: Engineers are leaving: education trains more people than research and universities can absorb. That slows the tree.
wissen.satz.bildung: {n} technologies are waiting for more engineers: education and universities open the tree, with years of delay.
wissen.satz.langsam: Research is slow (pace ×{tempo, number, 1}): raise the research budget.
wissen.satz.normal: Research is running at the 2026 pace. A bigger research budget speeds it up; more education opens new nodes.
wissen.e.sperre: The priority can only be changed again in {tage} days.
wissen.e.kapital: Not enough capital for this ({pk} needed).
wissen.e.schwerpunktAus: Research no longer has a priority.
wissen.e.schwerpunktWarum: Labs, funding and posts follow the priority: this branch moves faster, the others a little slower (game parameter).
wissen.e.keineLizenz: Nobody offers a licence for this.
wissen.e.partnerGesperrt: {land} is currently blocking deliveries and licences.
wissen.e.keinPartner: There is no foreign partner for this plant.
wissen.e.nichtMoeglich: This is not possible right now.
wissen.e.lizenzWarum: A licence saves years, costs capital and fees and creates dependence: if the licensor blocks, construction and plant stall. Its rival takes offence.
wissen.e.selbstWarum: Our own research is slower and less certain, but the knowledge stays in the country.
wissen.e.nichtLaufend: This is not running right now.
wissen.e.schonLizenz: There is already a licence for this.
wissen.durchbruch.werk: The plant is producing: fewer imports, and the domestic defence industry moves a step forward.
wissen.durchbruch.wissen: New knowledge opens the next nodes of the tree.
wissen.sperre.log: {land} blocks licences and deliveries: licensed projects stall, plants with foreign technology produce less.
wissen.sperre.warum: Dependence is the price of the licence (game parameter).
wissen.traeger.staat.name: State-owned plant
wissen.traeger.staat.text: Full cost on the debt; in return, knowledge and yield stay in the country.
wissen.traeger.firma.name: Domestic company
wissen.traeger.firma.text: The company bears 40% of the cost and demands a purchase guarantee (1 capital); business is pleased, but closeness can feed corruption.
wissen.traeger.ausland.name: Foreign partner
wissen.traeger.ausland.text: The partner bears 60% and builds faster; in return, less knowledge stays in the country, and if the partner blocks, the plant stalls.
wissen.ui.zweck: What the country can do, what it can learn next and what is still missing. Education opens the tree; the research budget drives it.
wissen.ui.etat: Research budget {budget, prozent, 1} of GDP, innovation ceiling {grenze, prozent, 1}
wissen.ui.schwerpunktPreis: A change costs {pk} capital: the chosen branch researches faster, the others a little slower. Then a one-year lock.
wissen.ui.rest: {n, plural, one {about # month left} other {about # months left}}
wissen.ui.ungewiss: Uncertain breakthrough: the project can fail, and then the money is lost.
wissen.ui.traegerWahl: Who builds and runs the plant?
wissen.ui.lizenzText: Licence: faster, but more expensive and dependent; the licensor's rival takes offence.
wissen.ui.tempoZeile: Pace ×{gesamt, number, 1}: research ×{forschung, number, 1} · brain drain ×{abwanderung, number, 1} · priority ×{schwerpunkt, number, 2} · licence ×{lizenz, number, 1} · operator ×{traeger, number, 2}
wissen.ui.auswahl: Choose a node to see its requirements, price and options.
wissen.ui.legende: Green: done · Gold: in progress · White: available · Grey: locked
